info.name: Talkpush Agents API Document Tags API API
Retrieve all the available document tags(templates) on the company account

params.name: api_key
params.description: The API key provided for your application

params.name: include_default
params.description: Optional. If sent as true the default document tags created with the company are returned. Default to false.

items.docs: This endpoint let's you retrieve all the available document tags(templates) on the company account.
